description: exp021 - champion exp010 with EXACTLY ONE change: the Linear(D=384->V=32768) unembedder replaced by HyperplaneCodeLUT(input_dim=D=384, nap=15 -> V=2^15=32768, T=16 tables, anchor-pairs init, w_cell const 0.02). Byte-identical to exp010 otherwise: E=D=384 DUAL STREAM (E-stream + D-stream), BOTH residual LUTs (per-layer residual_lut x6 + emb_resid_lut), MeanAbsNorm pre-norms (NOT LayerNorm), ln_final(D) LayerNorm feeding the unembedder (code-LUT reads ln_final(x_resid), the D-stream). 6 layers, 6 heads d_qk=d_v=64, ctx512, vocab32768, RoPE1e4, untied tok_emb, LUT qk nap4/tph256 v nap6/tph256 out_proj nap7/tph512 residual nap6/tph256 emb_resid nap6/tph256 (HyperplaneMHL anchor/hard, bf16 tables/fp32 hyperplanes), seed 42, 16000 steps, 24576 tokens/step, LR over 16000 (warmup1600 cosine 0.1x floor), Lion lut_lr 2e-4 tables / AdamW adam_lr 3e-4 (hyperplane w/b incl code-LUT no-wd by name; w_cell wd0.1 - the old Linear-unembedder slot; tok_emb/norms wd0), grad clip 1.0, eval_every 200. Purpose: isolate whether the code-LUT unembedder underperforms at scale INDEPENDENT of the single-stream reduction. Baselines: exp010 dual-stream Linear 1.1940; single-stream code-LUT exp019 (anchor)/exp020 (random) for cross-reference. Param expectation ~= 324.7M - 12,582,912 Linear + 616,688 code-LUT ~= 312.76M.
